title: Expired 2025 Third-Party Contractor VPN & Static SSH Key SOP

pages.content: EXPIRED SOP NET-VPN-2025-03: External engineering contractors are permitted to connect to staging bastion hosts on TCP port 2222 using static RSA-2048 SSH keys rotated manually every 90 days.
EXPIRED SOP PROFILE-EXT-LEGACY: Contractor VPN profile PROFILE-EXT-LEGACY grants split-tunnel routing to internal staging subnet 10.44.0.0/16 upon email approval from a project manager.
